name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PointInsert.cover_flip_keeps_allowed
title: A cover flip keeps every pad alive only on allowed prefixes
statement: Pads and clauses are 0/1 slot programs indexed by level and bit. Suppose every pad is alive only on allowed prefixes (of length at least 1), and every prefix that fully falsifies a clause (all later entries of the clause are 1 and the prefix keeps it alive) is allowed. Flip one entry (L, b) of pad d using a cover (another pad or a clause) that has the same entries as d above L, entry 1 at (L, b) and only 1-entries after L. Then every pad is still alive only on allowed prefixes.
